scope: mock-only; no API, worker or database was involved
checks: OIDC authorization code exchange validates S256 PKCE
invalid PKCE verifier is rejected by the synthetic token endpoint
synthetic ID token signature verifies with the served JWKS
issuer, audience, nonce and synthetic subject claims match
one-shot 503 failure and subsequent success are controllable
malformed and oversized valid JSON responses are controllable
a held inference request can be aborted
